Drop the FDIS site visits that cannot carry evidence, and count every drop

Source: R/fdis_quality.R
knw_fdis_quality.Rd

The quality drops scripts/0290 and 0294 applied to 0230's site table, in that order: a visit not placed on the FWA network, a pick beyond its placement limit (see knw_fdis_place()), an FDIS 1:50k watershed code that names no stream within the snap search, a junk date, a sentinel effort or no effort at all (a visit with only one of area and time is kept, so a model can use either), and a catch whose status is unknown (neither fish nor an explicit zero). Each drop is one ledger row, and the drops and the kept rows partition the input, which the function asserts.

Usage

knw_fdis_quality(sites)

Arguments

sites

data.frame of site visits as 0230 builds them, with the flag columns flag_not_placed, flag_far_snap, flag_ws50_mismatch, flag_junk_date, flag_effort_sentinel, flag_no_area, flag_no_effort and catch_status.

Value

A list: kept, the visits that pass, and ledger, a tibble with columns kind (in, drop, kept, info), step, n and note. Where sites carries 0230's snap_confirmed and snap_moved, two info rows count the kept visits confirmed by their 1:50k code and those moved to a named stream that is not the nearest; they are not part of the partition.

Examples

sites <- data.frame(
  site_visit = c("a", "b", "c"),
  flag_not_placed = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE), flag_far_snap = FALSE,
  flag_ws50_mismatch = c(FALSE, FALSE, NA), flag_junk_date = FALSE,
  flag_effort_sentinel = FALSE, flag_no_area = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
  flag_no_effort = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE), catch_status = "fish"
)
q <- knw_fdis_quality(sites)
q$kept$site_visit
#> [1] "a"
q$ledger
#> # A tibble: 8 × 4
#>   kind  step                        n note                                      
#>   <chr> <chr>                   <int> <chr>                                     
#> 1 in    visits_in                   3 ""                                        
#> 2 drop  not_placed                  1 "not placed on the FWA network"           
#> 3 drop  far_snap                    0 "snapped beyond the placement limit (one …
#> 4 drop  ws50_mismatch               0 "FDIS 1:50k watershed code names no strea…
#> 5 drop  junk_date                   0 ""                                        
#> 6 drop  effort_sentinel_or_none     1 "sentinel effort, or neither fished area …
#> 7 drop  catch_unknown               0 "catch neither fish nor an explicit zero" 
#> 8 kept  visits_kept                 1 ""
